slides.texte_overlay:
Subtle details that make you
more attractive without trying
Laughing easily. A real laugh at a good joke, even your own mistakes. People are drawn to someone who seems to enjoy life instead of guarding himself all the time.
Walking at an easy pace. Not rushing, not dragging. A relaxed walk with your head up shows a man who is comfortable in his skin and in no hurry to prove anything.
Wearing clothes that actually fit. Shoulders in the right place, trousers the right length. Fit matters more than any brand, and it changes your whole silhouette.
Speaking well of your exes and old friends. No bitterness, no drama. A man who stays respectful about his past shows he'll be respectful in the future too.
Remembering small details. Her favourite coffee, the name of her sister, the trip she mentioned. Paying attention is one of the most attractive things you can do.
Before: no idea what to talk about beyond work. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and stories that make people lean in to listen for a while.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: no idea what to talk about beyond work. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Now people lean in to listen.

slides.texte_overlay: Being good with kids and animals. Patient, playful, gentle. How a man behaves with those who can't impress him says everything about who he really is inside.
